name: cloth-manta-on-kraft
description: Book cloth for a case binding: unbleached cotton (manta) glued to a 120 g/m2 kraft backing (the paper-backed cloth a binder turns over greyboard), both with axis 1 along the spine. The kraft is the bottom layer (the glued side); the cloth is the outside. The glue line is not modelled. Written for Pliego's laminate golden (case-binding cartridge).
